siteMeta.title: gridscore — Grand Prix predictions & live leaderboard
siteMeta.description: Call pole, podium, fastest lap and more before every session. Points land the moment results are in; climb the season leaderboard and your private leagues.

home.headline: Call every session. Score every weekend.
home.lede: Pole, podium, fastest lap, first retirement, safety car. Each call locks when its session starts, and points land the moment results are in.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in to gridscore with a magic-link email to submit your calls and join the leaderboard.
signIn.lede: We use your email only to identify your picks. No spam, no digests — just enough to put your name on the leaderboard.
signIn.bullet1Copy: Pole locks at qualifying, the rest at lights out. Edit freely until then.
signIn.bullet2Copy: Standings move the moment a result is confirmed.
signIn.bullet3Copy: Invite friends with a code and race on your own table.
signIn.cardLede: Use your email. We'll create the account on the fly if it's your first time.
signIn.newHere: New here? Just enter your email — your account is created instantly.
signIn.checkInboxBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and expires soon.
